decisions.mark: states that the shipped mbedtls_config.h leaves BOTH threading macros undefined, so a default build defines neither
decisions.detail: QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` defaults off (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`). ... `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` also default off (`mbedtls_config.h:2196`, `:2185`). | WHY: The answer says the threading macros "default off", but ties that to the header gate definitions, not to the shipped config leaving them undefined. It also names three macros rather than the two in the item, and says the index was built with both THREADING flags set, which muddies the claim that a default build defines neither. || QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` defaults off (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`). ... `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` also default off (`mbedtls_config.h:2196`, `:2185`). | WHY: The answer says the threading macros "default off" but also says the index was built with both flags set and that it did not verify a build. It never states that the shipped config header leaves them undefined, so a default build defines neither. || QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` defaults off (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`). ... `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` also default off (`mbedtls_config.h:2196`, `:2185`). | WHY: The answer says the threading macros "default off" in the header but never states that the shipped config leaves them undefined. Its note that "the index was built with both THREADING flags set" muddies whether a default build defines neither.

decisions.mark: concludes that a default build of mbedtls creates no threads at all, and that the pthread example compiles to a stub main under that condition
decisions.detail: QUOTE: "`MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` defaults off... by default, nothing inside the library runs concurrently and no mutex is taken... None of these are in `library/`.
